summary: Root Ventures is a San Francisco deep tech seed fund run by engineers that specialises in leading initial funding for founders tackling new technical opportunities. Its homepage states initial investments typically of $3,000,000 to $5,000,000, a selective few new deals a year and two thirds of its funds held in reserve. Portfolio descriptions include Esper, Particle, Mashgin, Zed and Kayhan. Geography, an application route and a street address are not stated on the page.
